title: ShrineRow
description: A single shrine record as stored in the canonical dataset (data/shrines.json).

Name.description: Primary English name of the shrine or sacred site.

Founded/Opened.description: Year or century of founding, free-text (e.g. '1898', '16th century CE').

Sufi Saint.description: Name of the saint buried at or associated with the shrine.

Image 1.description: Primary image URL (must be http/https or empty).

Image 2.description: Secondary image URL (must be http/https or empty).

Events.description: Description of annual events, urs celebrations, etc.

Description.description: Main prose description of the shrine.

id.description: Stable row identifier. Also the directory name under `public/photos/` for self-hosted images. Not the URL slug — that is derived from `Name`.

category.description: Faith tradition of the site, in the current vocabulary: Muslim Shrine, Hindu Temple, Sikh Gurdwara, Nanakpanthi / Udasi Darbar, Jain Temple, Secular / Memorial. Supersedes the legacy `Category` column, which is still read as a fallback.

site_type.description: The built form of the site, as a short term. Qualifying prose belongs in `site_type_note`.

status.description: Whether the site is in use: Active, Occasional, Heritage, Ruin or Destroyed. Qualifying prose belongs in `status_note`.

support_level.description: How well the entry is evidenced.

principal_figure.description: The figure the site is dedicated to or associated with. Supersedes the legacy `Sufi Saint` column. A row may name more than one figure.

figure_type.description: What kind of figure `principal_figure` is, in the vocabulary: Sufi saint, Deity, Sikh Guru, Sant, Historical person, Individual, Collective. A small number of rows carry a longer qualifying phrase instead, which the archive keeps rather than flattening.

silsila.description: The Sufi order or spiritual lineage of the site’s figure, as the archive’s source states it — including where the source answers with descent or personal affiliation rather than with an order.

year_built.description: Year the site was built, where the archive records one.

year_built_precision.description: How exact `year_built` is — typically exact, circa, century, range or unknown. A few rows carry a longer qualification instead.

year_built_note.description: Qualifying prose about `year_built`, including where the archive’s sources disagree or where the recorded year may refer to something other than construction.

figure_born.description: Birth year of the principal figure, where recorded.

figure_died.description: Death year of the principal figure, where recorded.

event_year.description: Year of a dated event associated with the site.

qa_note.description: Free prose recording what is uncertain, contested or unverified about the entry.

needs_review.description: A short code naming an unresolved question about the row, such as `figure_unresolved` or `events_placeholder`.

flags.description: Semicolon-separated processing markers recorded by the data pipeline, such as `DATE_SPLIT` or `NEW_FROM_FIELD_SURVEY`. Editorial bookkeeping, not a claim about the site.
